description:
List conversations

Returns a page of conversations, newest first. One `type` is listed at a time: `voice` returns call records and `chat` returns widget and WhatsApp threads. Every item carries a `type` field so a client can tell the two shapes apart without remembering which query it sent. The pagination object reports `page`, `perPage`, the `type` that was listed and `total`, a real count of the conversations of that type on the account.

page.description: Page to return. Starts at 1; values below 1 are clamped to 1.

perPage.description: Items per page. Clamped to the range 1 to 100; larger values are reduced to 100.

type.description: Which kind of conversation to list. Any value other than `chat` is treated as `voice`.

name: list_conversations
title: List conversations
